text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. BJW Residences Limited Partnership is constructing a 47-storey residential development building at 99 Blue Jays Way. The site is located on the southeast corner of Blue Jays Way and Mercer Street. A three-metre-wide portion of the eastbound curb lane on Mercer Street, between Blue Jays Way and a point 62 metres east, and a one-metre-wide portion of the westbound curb lane on the first lane south of Mercer Street, are currently closed to accommodate construction staging operations for the development. Toronto and East York Community Council, at its meeting on December 2, 2020, approved the subject construction staging areas on Mercer Street and on the first lane south of Mercer Street from December 3, 2020 to May 31, 2022. Continued to designate the public lane system bounded by Blue Jays Way, Mercer Street, John Street and Wellington Street West as one-way eastbound/northbound. 4.
